7378.title: Cursor Auto alias is forwarded as a native ACP model identifier
7378.rootCauseOneLine: Cursor session construction forwards the catalog alias default instead of resolving it to the native auto identifier.
7378.proposedFix: Translate the Cursor default family to native auto only at outbound session model selection, preserving the existing catalog.
7378.caveats: Two same-agent trusted-base runs prove the deterministic bridge defect; live Cursor authentication, rejection wording, and WSL behavior were not exercised. Complete minimal reproduction is inline in the report.
